intent_summary: Residual rules identify location shifts, trends, oscillation, mixture patterns, and short-term variation beyond isolated point departures.

criteria.criterion: Nelson location rules and CUSUM can identify a sustained residual location shift without any point-threshold crossing.
CUSUM reports the first detection position, direction, accumulated score, and configured threshold.
Trend, oscillation, and mixture findings retain their specific pattern meanings.
Moving-range findings identify variation changes separately from location changes.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected location_shift_up: zero point episodes and distinct overlapping Nelson/CUSUM/oscillation findings, with rule-specific detection positions.
